identity_anchors.eyes: large almond-shaped hazel eyes, attentive expression
identity_anchors.hair: short dark curly bob, shoulder-length, one curl falling near the right cheek
identity_anchors.facial_features: small rounded nose, defined cheekbones, friendly confident smile
identity_anchors.signature_detail: small turquoise star-shaped earring in the left ear

wardrobe_anchors.default_outfit: mustard-yellow blazer over a dark teal shirt
accessories: small black studio headphones when recording

visual_style.linework: clean expressive linework with soft painterly shading

dim library with warm practical lights

prompt_template.identity: same character Nour, late-20s Arab female cartoon podcast host, soft oval warm olive face, large hazel almond eyes, thick arched dark eyebrows, short dark curly bob with one curl near the right cheek, thin round glasses, turquoise star-shaped earring in the left ear
prompt_template.wardrobe: mustard-yellow blazer over dark teal shirt, small black studio headphones when recording
prompt_template.style: high-quality 2D cinematic cartoon illustration, clean expressive linework, soft painterly shading, warm studio key light, soft teal rim light, consistent color palette
prompt_template.positive_prompt: {{IDENTITY}}; {{WARDROBE}}; {{STYLE}}; scene: {{SCENE_DESCRIPTION}}; camera: {{CAMERA_AND_COMPOSITION}}; no readable text in the image
prompt_template.negative_prompt: different person, different face, different hair, long straight hair, different eye color, missing glasses, missing turquoise earring, wrong blazer color, extra fingers, deformed hands, duplicate person, distorted face, blurry face, low detail, photorealistic style, 3D render, watermark, logo, readable text, random letters, cropped head

reference_requirements: neutral, focused, surprised, and concerned expressions

required_identity_features: turquoise star earring on the left ear
reject_if: left earring is missing in a visible profile
hands or face are visibly deformed

sample_scenes.motion: slow pan from cassette toward her face

sample_scenes.description: close-up of Nour looking toward an unseen doorway after hearing a sound, subtle concern, warm light fading into teal shadows, no horror distortion
